headline: Yorkshire Water Chief Executive Nicola Shaw to Step Down in January
summary: Yorkshire Water announced that Chief Executive Nicola Shaw will step down in January. Shaw has led the utility since 2022, and her resignation follows a downgrade of the firm.
why: Yorkshire Water is one of the UK's major regional water utilities, where executive turnover and credit rating downgrades can affect infrastructure capital expenditure and debt servicing costs.

impacts.name: Yorkshire Water
impacts.why: The departure of the chief executive following a downgrade creates leadership transition uncertainty.
